title: ADF Copy failed—why did the watermark advance?
outcome: Repair an ADF-shaped incremental Copy configuration so partial failure cannot advance the checkpoint; replay with upsert restores exact target rows and tied upper-bound versions.
engine: isolated Python 3 state-transition model; T-SQL is an illustration and is never executed
scope: Azure Data Factory v2 + Azure SQL Database shaped subset; not Fabric, full ARM, deployed Azure or production transaction
source_assumptions: change_version is fictional monotonic application integer, not SQL rowversion or Azure automatic field
source rows inside captured window are stable during retry
full latest order rows, no deletes, refunds or history
new post-capture row has version greater than captured upper
keys/order/version/amount are nonnegative safe INT32 with positive version and unique order_id

ADF_shaped: Copy.typeProperties.sink.type AzureSqlSink/writeBehavior insert|upsert/upsertSettings.keys order_id or absent with visible PK
simulator_only: fault names and deterministic selected-row ordering
supported_subset.expression_support: Only exact named LookupOld/LookupNew firstRow or value[0] field accessors, matched to strictly Boolean firstRowOnly and shown output. JSON numeric0/1, strings, null, float, array and object are configuration errors before mutation. No arbitrary dynamic content, full ADF expression evaluator or output parameter support.
supported_subset.write_support: Upsert only by order_id explicit key or omitted key with the visible target order_id PK. amount_cents key rejected as unsupported/ambiguous in this simulator; no claim Azure globally rejects it.
supported_subset.procedure_effect: Fictional preprovided dbo.AdvanceOrdersWatermark replaces orders checkpoint with supplied Int when scheduled and not injected to fail. It does not internally recheck Copy status.

rendered_tsql_illustration: SELECT order_id,change_version,amount_cents FROM dbo.Orders WHERE change_version > @Lower AND change_version <= @Upper; -- rendered from simulator fields; never executed against Azure SQL
invalid_vs_unsafe: Malformed source, unsupported key/expression or bounds stop before mutation; valid >=, <, unbounded, insert, Completed run and expose incorrect state/selection.
assistance: Hint1: Which Copy final status is allowed to trigger AdvanceWatermark?
Hint2: When the same order is replayed, what happens with insert versus upsert by the visible primary key?
Hint3: Compare Lookup firstRow/value[0] to firstRowOnly, then test >lower and <=upper including both version104 rows.
reveal: Worked reference configuration is deliberate assisted/reviewed practice, not independent pass or job-ready score. Finite disclosed cases are not hidden mastery proof.
recovery: Each run has named input state, captured bounds, config revision and trace. Editing config retains draft/last trace but invalidates result. Retry same captured window only when explicitly selected; new run captures a new window. Cancel/stale results must not add transitions. Preserve last committed simulated state, including partial rows; reset asks before restoring baseline. Device-only state is not cloud save.
tradeoffs: Captured bounded window plus keyed upsert helps replay but does not make Copy and watermark one transaction. Staging plus transactional merge could strengthen atomicity but is not executed here. Real late/backdated updates, deletions, concurrent writers and checkpoint authority require a different consistency/CDC design.
